name: Primate Vision
description:
Primate Vision gives Claude the ability to actually watch and understand video.

Point it at a file or URL and ask questions in plain language: "when does the forklift enter the aisle?", "count the people wearing hard hats", "what happens after the door opens?" Claude gets back structured, grounded results — what was detected, where in the frame, and at which timestamp — instead of a vague summary.

It runs on Primate Intelligence's own scene-understanding models, built around predictive world models rather than frame-by-frame captioning. That means it reasons about objects persisting, moving, and interacting over time, so it holds up on questions that require tracking something across a clip rather than describing a single still.

Typical uses: reviewing security and safety footage, auditing operational or manufacturing video, sports and performance breakdowns, media logging and search, and QA on anything captured on camera.

Getting started takes about a minute. Sign up, create an API key, and connect — new accounts include free processing time, and no card is required for your first successful run. Usage-based pricing after that, with a free tier that stays free.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Primate Vision to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Primate Vision to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.primateintelligence.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Primate Vision MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Primate Vision provides these MCP tools: create_analysis, create_video_from_url, get_analysis, get_test_fixture, get_usage, list_models, and wait_for_analysis.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Primate Vision?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Primate Vision in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Primate Vision MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Primate Vision requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Primate Vision is developed by Primate Intelligence. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
